blocks.text: Condo buildings in Southwest Maple Ridge
Val Maria — 21163 Lougheed Highway

A 55+ age-restricted manufactured home park. It is not a condo and not a strata: listings for units in the park record the sub-type as Mobile Home / Manufactured Home and the ownership as "Leasehold not prepaid-NonStrata" — the buyer owns the home and rents the pad, and listing pages for the park are classified Southwest Maple Ridge. Do not count it as condo stock, and do not apply strata rules (Form B, depreciation reports, CRF) to it — none of them exist for a non-strata leasehold park.
Streets, schools and getting around Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: The sub-area's frame: the Pitt Meadows/Katzie boundary to the west, the Fraser River to the south, and the Lougheed Highway/Dewdney Trunk commercial corridor to the north — Hammond and Port Haney are its settled cores.
Rail/transit anchors sit at the sub-area's edges: Maple Meadows Station (20010 Dunn Avenue) to the west and Port Haney Station to the east, both on the West Coast Express.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: Floodplain and escarpment rules: the sub-area's river edge carries a flood construction level of 6.7 m geodetic and secondary suites are prohibited on floodplain properties; escarpment rules require a geotechnical covenant within 300 m of the crest and a detailed seismic report within 100 m, septic systems are to be avoided, and sewers are required for new residences.

blocks.text: Good to know about Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: Hammond is one of Maple Ridge's oldest settlements. It began as Port Hammond Junction, on CPR station land donated by the Hammond brothers — the heritage building stock around the Hammond core follows from that railway origin.
The bridge corridor is slated to widen. The Golden Ears Way expansion from 2 to 4 lanes is in design (City source) — the sub-area's main road link to Langley is a known future construction corridor.

A new aquatics/recreation centre is a live question, not a done deal. Proposed Hammond Aquatics/Recreation Centre and Multi-Use Community Park assent-vote bylaws (Bylaws 8123-2026 and 8124-2026) were put to voters.

The "condos" in Southwest search results are mostly not condos. With zero known apartment buildings and one manufactured-home park, attached listings marketed under this sub-area need form-by-form checking — manufactured homes, duplexes and houses with suites all surface under broad attached searches.

Septic and slope rules quietly shape lots here. Escarpment-area rules call for a geotechnical covenant within 300 m of the crest and a detailed seismic report within 100 m, septic systems are to be avoided, and sewers are required for new residences — costs a buyer of an older Hammond property can inherit on a rebuild.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Southwest Maple Ridge
Streets, schools and getting around Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: Silver Valley, which has its own City area plan, is a separate MLS sub-area in the northeast of Maple Ridge — it is not part of Southwest Maple Ridge, and its townhouse complexes (for example Windfall) are not this sub-area's stock.

Main roads and transit: Lougheed Highway runs along the north side; two West Coast Express stations bracket the sub-area — Maple Meadows Station (20010 Dunn Ave) on the west side and Port Haney Station (22300 River Road) at the east edge, with weekday trains between Waterfront (downtown Vancouver) and Mission City. The 743 and 744 buses loop through Hammond streets (207 Street, Lorne Avenue, Hammond) between Meadowtown and Haney Place via Maple Meadows Station; the 701 runs along Dewdney Trunk Road at the north edge and the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus runs on the Lougheed corridor north of the area.

Schools physically inside the sub-area: Hammond Elementary (K–7), 11520 203 Street; Maple Ridge Elementary (K–7), 20820 River Road; and Westview Secondary (8–12), 20905 Wicklund Avenue. SD42 has no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12).
School catchments: SD42 catchments are address-based, and the district locator does not always return a result. Confirm any address directly with SD42.
Parks and facilities: Hammond Park and the other parks nearby are listed in the
Southwest Maple Ridge guide
Health care: Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, Maple Ridge.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: Strata diligence — the Form B regime (any future strata townhouse): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. BCREA advises reviewing the Form B for the depreciation report, financial statements, CRF balance and planned work to identify future special levies.

The Hammond Area Plan (OCP s. 10.5) has been given final reading and adopted by Council, and its update enables mixed-use, higher-density buildings in the plan area — the route by which real townhouse stock could appear here. A Hammond Development Permit Area (heritage) applies to properties within the plan.
Lougheed Transit Corridor (the north edge of this area): the plan and what it allows are set out in the
Southwest Maple Ridge guide

Escarpment: the Fraser River Escarpment policy area (City Policies 6.23 and 6.24) is bounded by 207 Street west, 124 Avenue north, 224 Street east and the escarpment crest along the south; drainage from new construction must connect to the City storm system, properties within 300 m of the crest require a geotechnical report attached to a Section 219 covenant before a building permit, properties within 100 m require a detailed report on seismic slope failure, septic fields are to be avoided and new residences require sanitary sewers.
Buyer costs: the GST rebates, property transfer tax and the first-time buyer exemption are the same anywhere in BC; see
GST rebates in BC

blocks.text: Good to know about Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: The Lougheed corridor reading changed in January 2026 — cite it as adopted. Any older note calling the corridor plan merely proposed is superseded.

Hammond began as a railway land deal. The City records that the Hammond brothers, William and John, donated land to the CPR on the condition the first railway station in Maple Ridge be built in Hammond (Port Hammond Junction); the junction served as a supply depot as the community grew around the station, yards and a cedar mill — the origin of the heritage building stock around the Hammond core, and of the Hammond Development Permit Area (heritage) that applies within the Hammond Area Plan.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Southwest Maple Ridge is a board sub-area name only: the City of Maple Ridge publishes no boundary or plan under that name, and its neighbourhoods page instead lists Port Hammond and Port Haney in this corner of the city.
Port Haney, at the sub-area's east edge, was historically the steamboat landing and the Canadian Pacific Railway station area, and heritage buildings from around the city were relocated there.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: The adopted Hammond Area Plan update changes that pipeline: it enables mixed-use, higher-density buildings in the plan area and incorporates the additional density required by provincial legislation.

Port Hammond is a popular film location, and productions including Arrow and Flash return year after year to film in the Maple Meadows Business Park, which is part of the street character attached-home buyers would live beside.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Within 100 metres of the crest, a detailed geotechnical report addressing potential seismic slope failure is required, all drainage from new construction must connect to the City storm drainage system, and septic fields are to be avoided in the policy area.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Hammond Park, 20577 Lorne Avenue, has benches, a playground, a sport court, a tennis court and a pickleball court.
Hammond Community Park is the site of the Larry Walker and Hammond Stadium ballfields, Hammond Hall and the Hammond Outdoor Pool, and the Maple Ridge Golf Course is at 20818 Golf Lane in Hammond.

Hammond began as Port Hammond Junction: the City records that the Hammond brothers donated land to the Canadian Pacific Railway on the condition the first railway station in Maple Ridge be built in Hammond.

The Golden Ears Way expansion is a live road project on the sub-area's west side: the City states Golden Ears Way will be expanded from two lanes to four between the Highway 7 interchange and 210 Street, with detailed design underway.

items.t: Hammond Area Plan update, Official Community Plan s. 10.5: adopted by Council, enabling mixed-use, higher-density buildings in the plan area. Status: plan adopted (as of November 3, 2026).

Hammond Aquatics and Recreation Centre, 11509 207 Street / 20601 Westfield Avenue, on the current Hammond Community Park site, Loan Authorization Bylaw No. 8123-2026, and Hammond Multi-Use Community Park, 20818 Golf Lane, on the current Maple Ridge Golf Course site, Loan Authorization Bylaw No. 8124-2026: the City put both projects to an assent vote on October 17, 2026.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: A cost specific to this sub-area's riverfront lots: construction in the floodplain is identified by a covenant on title, and the flood construction level of 6.7 metres geodetic sets the lowest habitable floor, which affects what a strata can insure and rebuild after a flood event.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: getting around

items.t: The 743 and 744 run between Meadowtown and Haney Place via Maple Meadows Station and loop through Hammond streets including 207 Street and Lorne Avenue.

The 701 runs along Dewdney Trunk Road at the area's north edge, the 791 runs along the north side to Braid Station, and the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus runs on the Lougheed Highway corridor north of the area.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Escarpment is the first check here: the City's escarpment package maps the policy area between 207 Street, 124 Avenue, 224 Street and the crest, and states the geotechnical and covenant requirements that follow a lot inside it.

Flood is the second: Hammond fronts the Fraser River to the south, and the City's floodplain material sets the 6.7-metre flood construction level and the covenant that identifies floodplain construction on title.

Heritage review is the third: a Hammond Development Permit Area applies within the Hammond Area Plan, so exterior changes in older strata or mixed-use buildings can need a permit a newer sub-area would not.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 condos and townhomes listed in Southwest. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Southwest?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Southwest had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Southwest a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 8 condos and townhomes sold in Southwest over those 5 months, out of 230 in all of Maple Ridge.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Southwest from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?

faq.a: No named apartment-condo building in Southwest Maple Ridge could be confirmed from official, directory or listing sources; the sub-area's housing is detached homes, and its one named attached property (Val Maria) is a manufactured home park.
faq.q: Are there any condos in Hammond or Port Haney?

faq.a: It is not a condo and not a strata — listings record ownership as "Leasehold not prepaid-NonStrata" and the form as a manufactured home in a 55+ park, meaning the home is owned and the pad is rented. There is no strata, no Form B, no depreciation report and no CRF; financing and resale work like a manufactured-home purchase, not a strata purchase.
faq.q: Is Val Maria a condo? Can I get a normal condo mortgage on it?

faq.a: No. The Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2 age-bylaw framework (including its exemptions) applies to strata corporations. Val Maria's 55+ restriction is a park tenancy rule under a leasehold, non-strata structure — ask the park for its own rules document rather than relying on strata law.
faq.q: Does the 55+ rule at Val Maria work like a strata age bylaw?

faq.a: The planning door is open: a Hammond Area Plan update enables mixed-use, higher-density buildings, and current listings already show SSMUH-era infill being marketed in Hammond (a permit-ready six-plex listing at the Hammond entry off Lougheed Highway). No condo project in the sub-area is confirmed as built or selling.
faq.q: Will condos ever be built in Hammond?

faq.a: The river edge is floodplain: the flood construction level is 6.7 m geodetic, and suites are prohibited on floodplain properties. Exposure is parcel-specific along the low Hammond flats — check the specific lot against the City's floodplain mapping rather than the sub-area label.
No. Val Maria (21163 Lougheed Hwy) is a 55+ manufactured home park — listings record "Leasehold not prepaid-NonStrata" ownership, meaning you own the home and rent the pad.
faq.q: Is Val Maria a townhouse complex I can buy into like a strata?

faq.a: That is The Maples Housing Co-operative — 31 semi-detached homes held as a co-operative, not strata lots and not fee-simple townhouses. A purchase there is a co-op membership transaction with its own approval and financing rules.
